description_en: Revokes permissions on databases and database accounts from a user group
description_zh: 移除给用户组授权的数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-database-accounts-from-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2v120f0y --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group from which you want to revoke permissions on databases and database accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权数据库和数据库账户的用户组ID。
